status: Retrospective documentation of completed analysis plus a frozen reserved evaluation; this file was created after observing the 2025-formation results and is not an earlier preregistration.

H1.hypothesis: Mean cluster-peer forward correlation exceeds mean sector-peer forward correlation (delta_rho > 0).

H2.hypothesis: A shared-cluster indicator has a positive coefficient in pairwise forward correlation regressed on shared-sector and shared-cluster indicators, with an intercept.
H2.role: Formulated after the primary result; retrospective evidence is explicitly exploratory.

return_basis: Daily vendor close price returns; first forward daily return includes the formation close. No future index-membership filter or cluster refitting.
market_adjustment: Separate OLS of each instrument daily return on J200 return with an intercept within each evaluation window; analyse residual correlations.
primary_weighting: Equal weight per unique within-group instrument pair; exclude the INL/INP mutual pair. Company-balanced estimates are a separate sensitivity, not substituted here.
bad_print_rule: The original script masks absolute daily returns above 0.4. Complete constituent/J200 forward data used here contain no such moves; no rule was tuned to improve outcomes.

random_group_test.procedure: Shuffle cluster labels across instrument nodes, preserving cluster sizes; compare mean within-cluster correlation. One-sided p=(1+number(null>=observed))/(1+B).

interval.procedure: Resample contiguous ten-day blocks synchronously across the entire return panel, with replacement; allowed starts are 0 through T-10. Concatenate blocks and truncate to T; report 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of delta_rho. No independent-pair standard errors.

incremental_test.procedure: Keep return correlations and sector indicators fixed, shuffle cluster labels across instrument nodes, refit OLS, and compare cluster coefficients using the same plus-one one-sided p formula. Preserves node-induced pair structure; interpretation depends on label exchangeability and is exploratory, not causal.

reserved_evaluation.status_at_freeze: Not executed; no output_prospective/ or full-window cache present. Existing beta cache may include early-July prices, but they are excluded from these frozen inputs.
reserved_evaluation.timing: Protocol fixed after this window began, so the complete July-December evaluation is held out, not fully prospectively preregistered. Legacy --prospective command name does not change that fact.
reserved_evaluation.frozen_labels: June-2026 labels, all five UMAP seeds and the t-SNE comparator are preserved in inputs/partitions.csv. No post-June-2026 prices are included; this is a label freeze, not an evaluation.

reproduction: reproduce.py reuses unchanged analytical functions and reads frozen inputs; writes only to .runtime/comovement-reproduction and compares all saved outputs.
